name: The Boatyard
summary: A beach bar and restaurant on Carlisle Bay, open every day from 9am to 6pm. A day pass covers loungers, the ocean trampoline and other water toys, and a 45 minute boat trip to snorkel over the bay's shipwrecks. There are no reservations: passes are sold on arrival, first come, first served.
standouts: 45 minute shipwreck and snorkel tour included in the day pass
Ocean trampoline, iceberg, Free Fall Xtreme, rope swing and dive platform on site
Transport back to the cruise terminal for cruise passengers and crew (special conditions apply)

contact.address: The Boatyard Bar and Restaurant, Bay Street, St. Michael, Barbados

trips.title: Shipwreck and Snorkel Tour
trips.summary: A 45 minute boat trip from the beach club to snorkel over the shipwrecks in Carlisle Bay. It is included with the day pass, along with loungers, umbrellas, water toys and showers. Sign up on arrival, as places go on a first come, first served basis.
highlights: 45 minutes, snorkelling over shipwrecks in Carlisle Bay
Included in every day pass except the crew rate, where it is US $5 extra
Day pass credit can be spent at the bar and restaurant
Non-swimmers can join but must stay on the boat
trips.departsFrom: The Boatyard, Bay Street, Carlisle Bay

checkNotes: Mainly a beach bar, restaurant and day-pass venue; the marine activity is the 45 minute shipwreck and snorkel tour included in the pass. The site says no reservations are taken (first come, first served). A Wix 'Book Online' page exists at /book-online but is not in the menu or sitemap and showed no services in its page source, so it is not recorded as a booking link. Luggage storage is US $5 per bag. The site also links to sister venues Sharkey's, Mimosas and Tabu, not covered here.
